purpose: Govern the intentional accumulation and resolution of provisional knowledge, assumptions, shortcuts, undefined concepts, and incomplete formalizations across the Mono-Process Framework.
definition: Research Debt is knowingly accepted incompleteness that enables continued program progress while creating an obligation for future resolution.

governance.rule: All intentional incompleteness SHALL be registered. Unregistered debt SHALL NOT be relied upon for promotion.

debt_types.description: Definition exists but lacks sufficient validation.
Expected theorem or lemma not yet established.
Knowledge exists but is not formally documented.
Required governance policy has not yet been established.
Known tool invocation, packaging, or environment behavior gap that affects governed execution without changing theory claims.
